text: The Nominating Panel - Sign Variance Committee will conduct interviews and recommend three candidates, including a Chair, to City Council for appointment to the Sign Variance Committee.

The Nominating Panel - Sign Variance Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Sign Variance Committee: Candidate #SVC1-94 Candidate #SVC1-107 Candidate #SVC1-121 Candidate #SVC1-133 Candidate #SVC1-143 Candidate #SVC1-144 Candidate #SVC1-155 Candidate #SVC1-158 Candidate #SVC2-40 Candidate #SVC2-33 Candidate #SVC2-35 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (May 17, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Sign Variance Committee.
